display_name: PAMF 参考路由稳定性物理关系三种子配对补跑
scope: Phase1 ManySig F0; old full reference-response PAMF; 3 SIG-TIME views; natural order. Train seeds 2026092702 and 2026092703 and combine with the already dispatched seed 2026092701 of the identical method.
source_permissions: Existing same-contract L_s/U_s/V; U transmitter identity hidden; no target inputs or truth during training. Each row loads only its own matching F21 scratch E20 prefix and continues own E10+E20.
method: Unchanged pamf_ptbr_route_v1. Ordinary PL .95/weight 1, five physical relations beta .5 and L/U weights .05. A changed bounded-echo delay index zeros only that sample's reference finite-difference direction.
controls: same-seed complete Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, shuffled time, raw cross_rx and cross_both
evaluation: Fixed E50. Freeze both rows' clean and six practical predictions before independent truth-last scoring. F0 raw cross_rx plus cross_both are primary; existing DURA readouts and cross_date remain diagnostics. No leo_weak. Report accuracy and paired corrections and regressions by scene and TX/RX/day for each seed, followed by the three-seed summary.
resources: N607 ordinary account, GPU 0 and 1, at most two observed or pending processes per card; preserve other owners.
execution: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_route.publish --replicate --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: Existing project Python, FP32/TF32 off. Git commit recorded by publisher. Unique PROJECT/releases/RUN-release CWD and PROJECT/runs/RUN output root.
stop_rule: Systemic training, prediction or scoring failure stops new dispatch. Preserve healthy workers and outputs. A short source smoke covers both real E20 prefixes; no additional source diagnostic jobs for the replication rows.
expected_artifacts: source-only checkpoint smoke for both seeds
E50 source completion and physical routing state for both seeds
frozen seven-scene predictions for both seeds
independent truth-last scores and three-seed paired analysis
limitations: Replication matrix fixed before reading candidate target scores. Historical F0 benchmarks were exposed. Ordinary PL and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL differ in training and temporal order; comparisons are method-level.
